name: Sitri
title: Levite of the family of Kohath
summary: Sitri was a Levite, son of Uzziel, from the family of Kohath in the tribe of Levi. He is mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites in Exodus. Although he does not play a prominent role in the biblical narrative, he is part of the important Levitical lineage that served in the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites
keyEvents.description: Sitri is listed as one of the sons of Uzziel, son of Kohath, son of Levi, in the register of the Levites.

keyEvents.title: The role of the family of Kohath among the Levites
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Kohath, including the Zithri family, were given responsibility for the most holy items in the tabernacle during the wilderness journey.

keyEvents.title: The Role of Uzziel's Sons
keyEvents.description: Zithri's brothers, Mishael and Elzaphan, were appointed by Moses to carry the bodies of Nadab and Abihu out of the camp after they were struck down before the Lord, demonstrating the family's close connection to sanctuary service.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Levi Chosen for Service
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Levi, to which Zithri belonged, was chosen by God to serve in the sanctuary and perform priestly duties on behalf of all Israel.
